title: Product metrics boards
subtitle: PostHog dashboards for the portfolio products. All figures are demo / synthetic unless a product case marks evidence as production.

boards.name: AI Defence Ecosystem v2
boards.summary: Executive programme dashboard unifying AI-SPM, AI SOC, and AI Policy Foundry.
boards.question: Is our AI estate secure, governed, and actively monitored?

screenshots.caption: Executive KPIs: AI assets under management, security incidents created, policies enforced; risk distribution and assessments over time.
Cross-pillar signals: weekly active users across platforms, audit reports generated, compliance pass rate by framework, exemption approval rate.

boards.name: AI Policy Foundry — Safety, Satisfaction & NPS v2
boards.summary: Safety and compliance trends, user satisfaction, weekly retention, and NPS detail for policy automation.

screenshots.caption: Safety & compliance: policy lifecycle funnel and exemption approval rate.
NPS detail: score over time, distribution, and breakdowns by feature, aspect, and tier.

boards.name: AI SOC Portal – Operations Dashboard v2
boards.summary: Analyst activity, alert throughput, incident response times, AI recommendation performance, and workflow efficiency.

screenshots.caption: Daily active analysts, alerts worked per day, and alert triage funnel.
Median time to convert, total conversions, false-positive rate, and % positive AI feedback.

boards.name: AI-SPM Analytics v2
boards.summary: Full-funnel analytics for AI security posture: acquisition, onboarding, asset risk, and retention.

screenshots.caption: KPIs: signups, AI assets registered, risk assessments run, policy violations; activation funnel.
Assets by type and risk level, assessments over time, and policy violations by type.

boards.name: Agent Val — Product Metrics
boards.summary: Adoption and value funnels for agent-driven validation: nudge → session → autonomy → scope → validation launch, plus mix and retention.

screenshots.caption: Weekly active users, validations run, risk confirmation rate, and adoption funnel.
Mix: autonomy mode, remediation option/outcome, failure rate by industry; weekly retention.

boards.name: Ellyra Pulse v2
boards.summary: Clinical-trust intelligence: patient NPS and sentiment, safety-gate operations, companion performance, and engagement.

screenshots.caption: NPS & sentiment: average score, responses over time, and NPS by feature, aspect, and tier.
Share of responses by tier over time and weekly retention for accepted recommendations.

boards.name: Agritech Crop Insurance v2
boards.summary: Farmer acquisition, parametric payout triggers, field evidence, insurer console, and WhatsApp/voice channel activity.

screenshots.caption: Farmer acquisition & policy sales: purchase funnel by channel, language, and crop type.
